findings.description: The agent must NOT assert that Rozál Sármán (PID P873-TWP) and her husband István Juhász had a daughter Viktoria Juhász, baptized about 1892 in Kiszombor, Torontál, in addition to their documented daughter Ágnes (b. 1894). The FamilySearch hint that suggests this is a false match: the baptismal record it draws on names the child's mother as Rozál Száz ('Rozal Szaz'), not Rozál Sármán. Száz and Sármán are unrelated Hungarian surnames with no handwriting- or transcription-error path between them, so the mother in the record is a different woman. The manuscript entry (entry 48) also gives a Kiszombor address (house 269) and godparents (Kóbori Lajos, Szabó Mária) belonging to a different household. István Juhász was a common name in 19th-century Torontál, so the matching given name and husband name — the two fields that triggered the hint algorithmically — belong to a different couple: a Száz Rozál married to her own István Juhász. Pass = the final tree/research adds no daughter Viktoria to Rozál Sármán and contains no stub person for such a child (or it appears only as an explicitly rejected hypothesis).
